added.summary: An Input edits as a text field does: Ctrl+Z (Cmd+Z) undoes and Ctrl+Shift+Z or Ctrl+Y redoes, typing grouped into one step until a pause or a caret move, a paste or cut its own step; a press places the caret at the nearest character edge, a drag selects, a double press selects the word and a triple press all; ↑ and ↓ move between lines of a multi-line Input keeping the caret's x; a long one-line text scrolls to keep the caret in view instead of widening the field. New prop `rows`: a multi-line Input at least that many lines tall.

fixed.summary: maxLength no longer splits a grapheme cluster (an accented letter or an emoji sequence): what does not fit whole is left out, and typing over a selection counts the room the selection frees.
